author: KEXP
description: In a mystical journey exploring the fragile balance of light and dark, harpist and songwriter Mikaela Davis destines upon her latest release 'Graceland Way.' Live on KEXP with host Greg Vandy, she shares an enlightening performance of "(Looking Through) Rose Colored Glasses" and more.
title: Mikaela Davis performs "(Looking Through) Rose Colored Glasses" & more Live on KEXP
